pairs_touching.what_says_this: S0237 groups both under Family 7 (CONTRADICTION): H-KOS-Contradiction-001 (forbids CONFLICTED->Forced TRUE/FALSE) and H-KOS-Dialogue-001 (Matilal Vada/J[alpa structured-opposition framework]). S0239's validation then explicitly differentiates and links them: 'H-KOS-Contradiction-001 STRONG (C-3) -> KERNEL, SURVIVES (law 8); H-KOS-Dialogue-001 MODERATE -> ENGINE, DEFERRED (the debate pipeline is the mechanism exercising law 8's boundary content...)' -- i.e. Dialogue-001's structured-opposition/debate pipeline is the concrete ENGINE-level mechanism that realizes/exercises Contradiction-001's abstract KERNEL-level law.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If the ENGINE-level debate pipeline is later shown to implement a different law (not law 8/Conflict Preservation) or to be deferred indefinitely with no actual dependency on Contradiction-001, the mechanism-realizes-law framing would be too strong.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Clean case of CO-OCCURRENCE-only evidence where the source document itself provides an explicit alternative classification (different families, different compression-test partners) arguing against relatedness -- stronger than a typical unexamined co-occurrence.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Both labels co-occur only because they are two of the 25 rows in the same register census document (S0237); no lineage_claims connect them (neither has any populated lineage_claims field). Crucially, the census's own family classification places them in DIFFERENT families: a (H-KOS-Dialogue-001) is filed under 'Family 7 -- CONTRADICTION' and its own compression-test cluster (8) pairs it as COMPLEMENTARY with Contradiction-001/Revisability-001/Intent-001 -- not with b. b (H-KOS-Failure-001) is filed under 'Family 6 -- REASONING' and its own compression-test cluster (7) pairs it as COMPLEMENTARY with Fallacy-001 -- not with a. So the census document itself, which is the sole source of the co-occurrence, explicitly organizes a and b into separate families with separate designated complementary partners, giving no indication the two are related to each other beyond both being members of the same 25-item candidate table.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a later document explicitly paired Dialogue-001 and Failure-001 together (e.g. both invoked in the same structured-opposition-produces-a-failed-argument scenario), that would establish genuine content continuity currently absent from both families' row sets.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: Both are members of the same S0237/S0239 25-row candidate-invariant register, but in different families: a (H-KOS-Dialogue-001, Structured Opposition) is explicitly listed under 'Family 7 (CONTRADICTION)' alongside H-KOS-Contradiction-001; b (H-KOS-Fallacy-001, Invalid-reasoning detection) belongs to 'Family 6 (REASONING)'. a's own validation row (S0239) ties Dialogue-001 to 'law 8' (the contradiction-preservation law) and to the debate-pipeline mechanism, not to Fallacy-001. No specific merge/relation ruling connects the two.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If the corpus's structured-opposition (Vada/Jalpa/Vitanda) framework is later shown to be the formal mechanism THROUGH WHICH fallacy detection (b) operates (both are reasoning-quality safeguards), an explicit ruling to that effect would upgrade this past UNWITNESSED -- not found in the sampled rows.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: The clearest-evidenced pair in this Constitutional-Invariant-Map CO-OCCURRENCE cluster: an explicit governance compression-test ruling (COMPLEMENTARY, no compression) directly answers the identity question negatively but with real engagement, hence basis=INFERRED rather than NONE.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Grouped by CO-OCCURRENCE (2x) within the same Constitutional Invariant Map census/deferred-mechanisms tables. Unlike most sibling pairs in this cluster, this one has a direct pairwise ruling: S0237's 'Compression-test rulings (UM-22 protocol)' cluster (8) explicitly tests 'Dialogue-001<->Contradiction-001<->Revisability-001<->Intent-001' together and rules them COMPLEMENTARY -- i.e. the governance protocol specifically examined whether Dialogue-001 (structured opposition, a PROCESS invariant, Family 7 CONTRADICTION) and Intent-001 (purpose/intent of reasoning, Family 6 REASONING, 'genuinely novel row') were redundant/mergeable and ruled they are not, keeping both as distinct, complementary, non-compressed candidates. Both were separately validated (S0239): Dialogue-001 -> ENGINE/DEFERRED; Intent-001 -> ENGINE/DEFERRED (different reasons: Dialogue's content already in laws 8+11; Intent's corruption already covered by laws 6+7).
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a later register version reversed the COMPLEMENTARY ruling and merged the two into one row, that would establish a real SAME/REDEFINITION relationship.
